items.statement: Promoter holding will increase by 1.39% from 72.21% to 73.60% post-merger.
items.quote: Fifth, it is important to highlight that promoter holding will increase by only 1.39%. That is from 72.21% to 73 .60%.

items.statement: A promoter trust will hold 51% of the promoter stake to ensure continuity and alignment with long-term growth.
items.quote: Sixth and most importantly, we are creating a promoter trust that will hold 51% of the promoter stake in Dollar Industries Limited.

items.statement: 90% of related party transactions will vanish post-merger; only 1-2 individual and firm transactions remain.
items.quote: Basically, 90% of the related party transaction is vanished. Only there is -- if you check the RPT personnel, there is 1 or 2 individual and 1 or 2 firm also.

items.statement: Related party transactions of INR27-28 crores will be removed after the merger.
items.quote: plus the related party transaction of INR27 crores, INR28 crores also removed from the -- after this exercise.

items.statement: Receivable days targeted to reduce from current 112 days to 100-103 days in current year.
items.quote: Even current year, we have targeted to reduce our receivable days. Currently, it is around 112 days to reduce to around 100 to 103.

items.statement: Bhilwara project funded entirely from internal accruals without raising money from investors
items.quote: If you realize one thing, the company has not taken any money from the investors for the Bhilwara project for which the land is purchased. The work has been started. Most of the ordering and contracting and everything has been done. It's all been done by the company's internal accruals.

items.statement: Employee stock option plan rolled out at end of September 2025
items.quote: A big highlight internally has also been that we announced an employee stock option plan which got rolled out towards the end of September.

items.statement: Net cash flow from operations for H1 FY26 was INR1,291 million
items.quote: Net cash flow fr om operations for the half year stood at a robust INR1,291 million

items.statement: CFO Jagdish Agarwal will step down at end of next month after 3+ years
items.quote: As many of you may know, I'll be stepping down from my role towards the end of the next month.

items.statement: Promoter shareholding remains at 62.62% with 28% held by retail investors.
items.quote: The promoter shareholding has continued to be at 62.62 percentage whereas 28 percentage of this chunk -- sorry, of the remaining chunk has been with the retail.

items.statement: Closed sub-debt capital in the form of Tier 2 with PhillipCapital in Q2.
items.quote: So, in Q2, we have already closed on sub debt capital in the form of Tier 2, right, that we have closed with PhillipCapital, right?

items.statement: Fixed deposit book increased to INR46.07 crores with new deposits of INR7.52 crores and renewals of INR2.91 crores in Q2.
items.quote: The fixed deposit book of the company has started to increase now. We are at INR46.07 crores. The company has been able to take new fixed deposits at -- new fixed deposit of INR7.52 crores in Q2, whereas renewals stood at INR2.91 crores.

items.statement: DSO at 73 days with target of 65 days; cash generation was a record in Q2
items.quote: DSO continues to remain under control at 73 days with a target to be at around 65 days, which I believe is a good balance for us.

items.statement: Cash generation was a record in Q2 FY26
items.quote: And if you look at it from a cash generation perspective, this was a again another record for us in our history.

items.statement: Share count decreased by about 18 lakhs in Q2, likely due to extinguishing of stock options
items.quote: The share count has decreased by about 18 lakhs in this quarter. Is there something specific here? Or is it just extinguishing of some stock options?

items.statement: Board discussed buyback; CFO mandated to evaluate options
items.quote: It's something the Board has discussed. It was discussed this morning as well. We will evaluate all the options, and our CFO has been mandated to do that.

items.statement: Receivables over six months old are largely government and local body dues taking 6-24 months to pay
items.quote: Largely, this money which is more than six months old is the government of India, state government, panchayat, local district money, where they normally take minimum of six months going up to one year also, sometimes two years also.

items.statement: Cash and cash equivalents of Rs. 17.65 crores; company remains net debt free and committed to returning most free cash flow to shareholders
items.quote: The cash generation remains strong as our balance sheet remains healthy and continues to strengthen with the cash and cash equivalents of Rs. 17.65 crores and Ksolves continues to remain net debt free.

items.statement: Operating cash flow for H1 FY26 was negative Rs 483 crore including Rs 550 crore land purchases; adjusted operating cash flow was positive Rs 50 crore
items.quote: So on operational front, our operating cash flow for first half is about, which as per the financial statement what we have submitted is negative Rs. 483 crores. But it includes the land bought by us during last 6 months. So you can say Rs. 550 crores of land we have bought during last 6 months. So this is about positive Rs. 50 crores, operational cash flow.

items.statement: Management took a Rs 50 crore loan from holding company Pioneer as a conservative measure for strong growth; expects to fund internally going forward and not repeat such transactions.
items.quote: We have taken this loan as a conservative basis. Looking at the strong growth that we are seeing this year and strong margins, I think we should be able to fund ourselves internally. We have not applied for any increase in banking limits also. So, this is a very temporary arrangement and we don't see that happening repeatedly.

items.statement: IPO proceeds of Rs 420 crore earmarked for equity portion of solar cell line; total project Rs 575 crore with Rs 155 crore debt for the subsidiary.
items.quote: For the solar cell line, we have earmarked Rs. 420 crores out of my IPO to fund the equity portion of it. In addition to that, the total project is estimated to be around Rs. 575 crores. So, for that subsidiary, we will take a debt of close to about Rs. 155 crores.

items.statement: REA Group now holds 5.5% stake in Aurum PropTech after PropTiger acquisition
items.quote: REA now holds 5.5% at Aurum PropTech. And we are really glad that they have taken this leap of faith in the India PropTech ecosystem with Aurum PropTech.

items.statement: Issued 42,42,537 equity shares for 100% PropTiger acquisition at INR 86.45 crores
items.quote: During the quarter, the company has invested in 100% equity of PropTiger Marketing Services Private Limited for a consideration of INR 86.45 crores. The purchase consideration was settled by issue of 42,42,537 fully paid equity shares of the company.

items.statement: Operating cash flow turned positive in H1 FY26 due to working capital management and staged payment collection
items.quote: This year has been really well for us in terms of managing our working capital as well. And that has been the primary reason why we were able to generate cash flow from operation positive.

items.statement: Three independent directors resigned on September 26; one replacement appointed, two more expected in weeks
items.quote: On September 26, 3 Independent Directors resigned. And what I would like to reiterate there w ere no issues with the management, and it was a surprise. Subse quently, the company moved fast and appointed Ms. Mini Ipe, a former MD of LIC , as an Independent Director. We are taking steps to appoint 2 other Independent Directors in the next few weeks

items.statement: Limited review report for the quarter was qualification free
items.quote: during this quarter our limited review report has been qualification free.

items.statement: Cash balance of more than INR 1,500 crores available to fund disbursements for next quarter or so
items.quote: we have sufficient fund balance available in our system close to the more than INR 1,500 crores.

items.statement: Capital raise of INR 300-500 crores planned after board reconstitution, likely this financial year
items.quote: we are looking at a whole host of options and that -- we'll be taking it in the Board once the Board gets fully reconstituted and subsequently will be taking it up to the Board. And that is more f or a confidence capital per

items.statement: Operating cash flow turned negative in Q2 FY26 due to stretched working capital; management expects reversal in coming two quarters and positive cash flow by year-end.
items.quote: This quarter, we had, as I already talked about, a little stretch on the working capital. I think that led to this negative cash flow. Hopefully, things will ease out in the coming 2 quarters and we should be back to the positive number by the end of the year.

items.statement: Related party transactions are around 15% of total revenue, mostly with subsidiaries; money flows both ways and is counted twice for ROC disclosure.
items.quote: Sir, it is not 69%, it is 15.1% of the total revenue. Majority is with the subsidiaries. If we count INR15 crores, if the money goes and comes back, then it is treated as twice.

items.statement: Related party transactions expected to remain between 10%-15% of revenue; used for short-term funding in gold loan business at arm's length rates.
items.quote: No, it is between 10%-15%. It is still around 15%. We have to disclose it from the ROC perspective. In ROC, if the money comes and goes, we have to call the total of both.

items.statement: SEBI clearance obtained for Andhra Cement rights issue valid until December 2025; OFS option being evaluated; aim to complete before end of current financial year
items.quote: The regulations actually go all the way up to March of 2026. Yeah, we did apply and got the SEBI clearance for the rights issue. Up to December of 2025, the current application is valid. The option for an OFS also is something which we are evaluating.

items.statement: Promoter holding reduced by 4% due to repayment of loan against shares at renewal instead of pledging more shares
items.quote: There was a renewal already one year over and then at the time of renewal, either we have to pledge more shares or we have to repay, because of that, some shares were sold and then repaid, otherwise, nothing is there.

items.statement: Insurance claim of around Rs.70 crores expected including loss of profit; ad hoc amount expected in Q3
items.quote: Insurance amount expected is around Rs.70 crores including loss of profit. And we get the clarity, or we are expecting at least ad hoc amount in Q3.

items.statement: Working capital cycle around 120-130 days with DSO over 100 days, stock 60 days, payables 30 days; measures started to reduce DSO
items.quote: The working capital days, as of now, the DSO days are around more than 100-days is there. But now we have started measures for reducing first quarter to this quarter also there is a reduction.

items.statement: Shareholder approval taken for borrowing limit of Rs.1,000 crores under Section 180(1)(c) for future debt requirements, not for equity issuance
items.quote: This IPO utilization of Rs.1,000 crores is not there. That is anyway shareholders approval is there for any borrowing limits. That under Sec.180.1c, we have to take the approval of the shareholders.

items.statement: Q2 cash collections were Rs. 173 crores, the highest in company history, with deferred revenue of Rs. 94 crores as of September to be recognized in Q3 and Q4
items.quote: If you look at the collections we had system -wide in Q2, it is probably one of the highest this company has had in its history, we collected about Rs. 173 crores of cash.

items.statement: H1 cash flows were negative due to one-time payouts of Rs. 100 crores for J.K. Shah Education stake acquisition, non-recurring from next quarter
items.quote: So, there were one-time events like we acquired J.K. Shah Education of Rs. 100 crores payout during the current half year. We purchased 24% stake from the Mr. J.K. Shah, and we purchased the balance stakes from Veranda K12.

items.statement: QIP proceeds used to retire high-cost debt; commerce vertical to be debt-free post-demerger, residual business debt of Rs. 150-160 crores at 2.5-3x debt/EBITDA
items.quote: From the QIP base, the debt that is there in the commerce vehicle has been extinguished, so it's expected to list as a debt -free company. The balance debt that would be there post the demerger in the residual business would be roughly about Rs. 150 crores to Rs. 160 crores of the overall debt that was given by Ascertis.

items.statement: Vocational segment divested to SNVA EduTech via share-based arrangement; Veranda retains 50% joint stake in new global entity
items.quote: This transaction is structured as a share-based arrangement. SNVA EduTech will issue shares to Veranda and its subsidiaries, giving us a joint 50% stake in the new entity.

items.statement: Purchased 24% stake in J.K. Shah Education from Mr. J.K. Shah and balance stakes from Veranda K12 for Rs. 100 crores in H1
items.quote: We purchased 24% stake from the Mr. J.K. Shah, and we purchased the balance stakes from Veranda K12. So, there were financial liabilities being paid out in the current half year.

items.statement: Promoter debt of Rs. 50-60 crores EBITDA expected for residual business; promoter debt part of residual Rs. 150-160 crores debt
items.quote: The balance debt that would be there post the demerger in the residual business would be roughly about Rs. 150 crores to Rs. 160 crores of the overall debt that was given by Ascertis, and there is some debt from the promoters.

items.statement: Demerger scheme filed in late September; exchanges' queries answered; NCLT approval expected in 3 months; listing targeted June/July 2025
items.quote: The demerger scheme was filed during the last week of September. After the filing, we have already received the first set of questions from both the exchanges, which have been duly answered and sent back to them.

items.statement: INR 107 crores deployed from IPO proceeds for acquisition of prime land parcel from promoter
items.quote: As of September 2025, we deployed an additional INR107 crores for the acquisition of prime land parcel from our promoter and INR17 crores towards general corporate purposes.

items.statement: Indo Krates provided corporate guarantee and mortgaged immovable property as collateral for Dynamic Cables' working capital facility
items.quote: Indo Krates has given corporate guarantee against our bank guarantee limits, which we avail from the bank.
